item.title: Peoria City Council to discuss settlement with Boyd Gaming over Par-A-Dice's location
item.description: The city of Peoria is considering a deal with the owners of the Par-A-Dice Casino Hotel to receive additional revenues in exchange for dropping its legal challenge to the casino's planned redevelopment.

item.title: Man arrested after allegedly threatening to kill Bloomington officer during traffic stop
item.description: A man was arrested after threatening to kill a Bloomington police officer during a traffic stop, while a police dog search of the vehicle found cocaine in the center console.

item.title: Local leaders stuck on rooftop in Lacon to raise money for Hot Air Balloon Festival
item.description: The Lacon Chamber of Commerce hosted its first-ever Ransom on the Roof fundraiser, in which local business owners and community leaders raised money to come back down from a building, with the proceeds going to fund the Hot Air Balloon and Flight Festival.

item.title: Peoria celebrates Black History Month with bridge lighting
item.description: The city of Peoria is celebrating Black History Month by lighting the Murray Baker Bridge in the colors of the Pan-African flag on Sunday, Feb. 1.

item.title: Peoria police apprehend suspect in hit-and-run case
item.description: A Peoria man was arrested for allegedly hitting a pedestrian and driving away, failing to render aid during the accident.

item.title: Peoria School Board candidates share priorities during public forum
item.description: Four candidates running for the Peoria School Board discussed their priorities during a public forum, focusing on student achievement, accountability, district finances, school safety, and rebuilding trust with families.

item.title: Neighborhood House offers free hot meals every Sunday in South Peoria
item.description: Neighborhood House in South Peoria offers a free community meal every Sunday to combat food insecurity and social isolation, relying on volunteer groups to make it possible.

item.title: Deputy 'faces long recovery' after South Peoria shooting Saturday, Sheriff says
item.description: A Peoria County Sheriff's Deputy was shot while making a traffic stop in South Peoria late Saturday night and underwent successful surgery, and is now in stable condition.

item.title: UPDATE: Man arrested on attempted murder charge after shooting Peoria County deputy
item.description: A Peoria County deputy was seriously injured in a shooting late Saturday night, and Larry D. Bell, 51, was arrested on charges including attempted murder.

item.title: Peoria police locate woman who allegedly stole evidence from deputy shooting scene
item.description: Peoria police have located a woman who allegedly stole evidence from the scene of an officer-involved shooting.
